moat_against: AMD (Xilinx) and Intel (Altera) dwarf Lattice in R&D and can contest any socket that scales
Niche is small — moat protects a pond, not an ocean
Brutally cyclical end markets (industrial/auto/comms drove the 2024-25 collapse)
SBC load enormous and rising — dilutes shareholders' slice of cash economics
AI-server demand is hyperscaler-capex-driven, outside Lattice's control
moat_for: Leader in low-power small-form-factor FPGAs, the segment AMD/Intel underserve
Last fully independent FPGA maker — gets sockets platform owners won't prioritize
Design-win stickiness in long-lifecycle industrial/auto/server platforms
Security differentiation: Sentry PFR stack, hardware root of trust, post-quantum crypto
moat_justification: Leader in low-power, small-form-factor FPGAs with sticky design wins and a real security/PFR niche riding AI-server demand, but a niche player dwarfed in R&D by AMD (Xilinx) and Intel (Altera), exposed to brutally cyclical end markets (revenue fell ~31% peak-to-trough in 2024), and with cash economics heavily taxed by rising SBC ($143.6M TTM vs $243.2M TTM OCF).
name: Lattice Semiconductor Corporation
one_liner: Real low-power FPGA franchise (moat 5/10) inflecting on AI-server demand, but SBC-charged owner's earnings are $0.40/share against a $106 price — weighted IRR 4.1%, IV@15 $10.28; clears 15% only near ~$10.
